Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error by misinterpreting the metadata from the IMDb page. Specifically, in Step 11, the Planner incorrectly assumed that the `datePublished` field in the JSON-LD metadata (which was "2019-02-28") referred to the film's release date. In reality, `datePublished` on a webpage typically refers to when the page content was last updated or published, not the release date of the entity described. The Planner failed to distinguish between the film's actual release date (which the search results in Step 9 and 10 clearly indicated as February 28, 2019) and the metadata timestamp. This led to the absurd conclusion that the film "Dilan 1991" was released in 1991 (by combining the title's year with the month/day from the metadata), causing the Planner to incorrectly conclude that Dilan 1991 came out before Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World (2010). The correct release date for Dilan 1991 is 2019, making Celine the first film.
